_source: Story 054, decision D-062. Dust and grit kicked off the ground by DustFx (src/vfx/dust_fx.gd). Each kind is one burst: amount of puffs, life (s), speed range (m/s), spread (degrees around the direction), lift (upward share of the direction), size range (m), damping (how fast puffs slow), rise (m/s/s, dust drifts up), alpha (start opacity), both (true: sprays left and right, as on a landing; false: along the given direction). chips: small grit thrown up and falling back (count, speed, size). step_every_s: seconds between footstep puffs at full run (faster runs step faster). The colour comes from the room's theme ('dust' in data/world/themes.json). Story 058: puffs smaller and fainter, so a strike never piles a pale dome over the legs.
